acceptance: RUBRIC 1 live: name a CI (text edit) run whose workflow file includes 0e86fbbe8, started while the full CI run on the same head was in progress; its five verdict jobs finish within about a minute with the 're-run automatically' message
RUBRIC 2 refresh: the matching ci-text-edit-refresh run re-runs it after the full run completes and the rerun's checks match the full run's results
RUBRIC 3 nits: 4xx responses fail without retry and the unreachable assertion is removed, or the item records why not
description:
PR #3319 (merged 0e86fbbe8) changed CI (text edit) runs to decide once instead of polling for up to 110 minutes, and added ci-text-edit-refresh.yml to re-run the failed text-edit run when the full CI run completes. The refresh path was seen live on 2026-10-23 (refresh run 39889391545 re-ran text-edit run 39887697502 as github-actions[bot]; the rerun copied the full run's verdict in 5 s; text-edit completions were skipped, no loop). The immediate-exit path was not seen live: that run's first attempt used the pre-merge ci.yml and polled for about 19 minutes. Unit tests cover it.

Also from review: HTTP 4xx responses are retried like transient errors, and _with_retries has an unreachable assertion (nits).
